reading: Nearly 200 countries are trying to agree on a new world climate plan.
The talks are in Turkey, but the countries have not agreed on a plan.
Teams stopped talking for the night after the meeting ran more than a day late.
Some countries want a promise to use less fossil fuel, such as oil, gas and coal.
However, the latest plan says nothing about using less fossil fuel.
African countries also want promises of more money to prepare for climate problems.
Some teams are changing their flights from Sunday to Monday while they wait for a deal.
All countries must agree before they can make a deal.
The talks could stop if the countries cannot agree.
If the talks end without a deal, the countries will meet again next year.

vocabulary.definition: Meetings where people discuss something and try to agree.
Ideas about what to do and how to do it.
Words saying that you will do something.
A plan that two or more people or countries accept.
